scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c auto "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w engine && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w engine && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w engine && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
